ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 40% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels on the distal lobes and 60% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central peduncle area and trailing edge mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region dominated by a continuous low-intensity black blob. Distal lobes feature high-intensity white pigmentation interspersed with irregular, low-intensity dark mottling and horizontal streaks. Two distinct dark circular pixel clusters are located at approximately mid-lobe on the viewer's left.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of 1:8 relative to the horizontal width of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring high-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations. The viewer's right lobe exhibits a more chaotic topography with larger individual peaks (5-10 pixels) compared to the more uniform, lower-amplitude serrations on the viewer's left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow a convex trajectory sweeping upward and outward from the central axis, terminating in sharp, slightly recurved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, textured circular pixel groupings indicative of barnacle colonization localized on the outer distal edges and tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned linear disruptions visible, specifically a prominent horizontal dark line on the lower-left lobe and several faint diagonal scratches on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two prominent dark circular pitted scars on the viewer's left lobe; extensive barnacle encrustation on the lateral tips; irregular notch-like deformities along the trailing edge serration map.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'twin-spot' dark pigmentation pattern located in the interior quadrant of the viewer's left lobe.
